title: Cross-material cross-regime paired Richards timing
question: Does the selected derivative-consistent representation with logK tolerance 3e-4 deliver robust complete-Richards speed benefit across the frozen 12-case material/regime matrix?

timing_policy.compiler: gfortran -O3 without runtime checks or floating-point traps

fidelity_policy: All frozen F-AHL10 gates must pass before timing for a case is interpreted.

decision_rule.advance_broad_speed_candidate: median of 12 case medians < 0.98 AND no case median > 1.02
decision_rule.otherwise: retain as regime-dependent research candidate and classify where benefit is lost
